Hadith.1044 - Murazim ibn Hakim al-Azdi said:
"I was ill for four months and did not perform any voluntary prayers (nawafil) during that time.
I mentioned this to Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as),
Imam (as) said:
'There is no obligation upon you for making up those prayers. Indeed, the sick person is not like the healthy one. Whatever Allah (swt) has made overpowering upon him, Allah (swt) is more entitled to excuse him.'"
